notes.reference: Resample the same 60 independent stable reference people with replacement. Reuse each draw for all forecast people and dates. This does not create new independent participants.
notes.budget: 200 draws provide a bounded preliminary sensitivity check of the median and middle-half spread; the spread is not a 95% confidence interval or a validated uncertainty probability.
notes.formula: Keep the previously audited single-sample DNB formula, all proper tree branches, fixed original scaling and all-modules-valid rule. No epsilon replacement for an undefined ratio.
notes.controls: Apply identical reference draws to mean-deviation controls. Both supervised arms share node history and deviation uncertainty; only the DNB arm adds score and association-ratio stability.
notes.scope: Evaluate all original common forecast dates, never select people or days by errors or outcomes. Historical authored data have already been inspected. Preserve all comparisons, including lack of improvement.
